thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — gpu-pool-east1 saturated, queue growth detected (p50 latency > 1200ms, 5xx rate rising). Paging oncall.
ryan.oncall: I'm on it. seeing increased 429s in customer dashboards, which customers impacted? @oliver.cs can you surface top-3? :eyes:
oliver.cs: CS reports elevated error rates for two high-volume tenants in EU but traffic is routed through east1 for affinity. They're seeing 5–8x slowdowns and some request failures. Customers are on Dedicated and Hosted tiers.
maya.sre: I'm looking at autoscaler logs. autoscale-bot shows repeated scale attempts failing due to quota: "GPU_QUOTA_EXCEEDED" from cloud provider. Pool has 0 spare nodes to spawn.
autoscale-bot: Recent events:
- 2032023456 SCALE_ATTEMPT region=east1 requested=8 provisioned=0 reason=quota_exceeded
- 2032023460 SCALE_ATTEMPT region=east1 requested=4 provisioned=0 reason=quota_exceeded
- 2032023465 POOL_UTIL=98% queue=1350 pending
lena.runtime: If autoscaler is blocked by quota we need to either reduce load (throttle), route traffic elsewhere, or request emergency quota. Emergency quota request will take time.
jonah.ops: I can request quota but don't expect sub-30m turnaround. Recommend immediate cross-region spillover to eu-west2/asia-east1 as warm pools exist there.
ryan.oncall: Agreed. Priorities: 1) reduce customer impact (throttle or reroute), 2) open quota request, 3) observe and confirm fallbacks are healthy. Start playbook step 2: enable regional spillover route.
lena.runtime: Preparing route changes. Two options: a) service-level redirect by steering routing layer (preferred, preserves model variant), b) graceful degradation: serve a smaller model variant in east1 to reduce tokens. Steering will surge eu-west2 — check capacity there.
maya.sre: eu-west2 pool status: utilization ~65%, warm nodes available 12, can absorb ~600 concurrent gen tasks. Model variants: same family available but some variants are quantized; quality delta small for embeddings but not for long chats.
jonah.ops: I'll trigger routing flip using the routing API: POST /routing/steer with policy=spillover, target_regions=[eu-west2,asia-east1], max_rps_per_region=whatever. Command below:
```
# tentative
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/routing/steer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"id":"spillover-east1-2032","from":"east1","targets":["eu-west2","asia-east1"],"policy":"flood-if-saturated","threshold_pct":90}'
```
jonah.ops: Executed at 2032023472 — response: 202 Accepted. Routing layer reports "steer_in_progress".
incident-bot: Routing change observed: 40% of new requests from east1 now steered to eu-west2, 20% to asia-east1, 40% still local (soft-rollout).
ryan.oncall: Monitoring metrics now. @maya.sre please keep an eye on tail latencies and 5xx rates. @lena.runtime watch for model variant mismatches and function calling regressions.
maya.sre: After steering: east1 queue down from 1350 -> 480 over 45s, p50 latency down to 320ms, 5xx rate trending down. eu-west2 CPU/GPU utilization up to 78%, no errors.
lena.runtime: Noted ~0.6% of requests hit variant fallback because of quantization mismatch — logging shows "variant-compat-warning" but responses appear valid. We'll flag for eval later.
oliver.cs: Reached out to the two impacted customers, gave a short incident summary and temporary mitigation ETA ~15m. They're asking if there will be repeated throttles — told them we are enabling cross-region routing and working on quota fix.
jonah.ops: Quota request submitted to provider (ticket #Q-984321). ETA unknown. Also requested preemptible burst in east1 as a fallback but provider says preemptible pools are limited.
ryan.oncall: Next steps: keep steering until queue stable <200 and p50 < 200ms. If eu-west2 approaches 90% we should throttle low-priority routes or reduce model size for non-critical tenants.
maya.sre: Adding temporary rate-limit rule on heavy tenants via per-tenant token bucket. Command:
```
PATCH /config/rate-limits
{ "tenant_ids": ["tenant-123","tenant-789"], "max_rps": 0.2 }
```
Applied at 2032023480.
maya.sre: After rate limits and steering, overall pending queue ~120, east1 utilization 84%, eu-west2 72%, 5xx down to baseline. No additional paging.
john.doe: (note: john not in participants) -- ignore
lena.runtime: I'll schedule a postmortem to look at autoscaler backoff logic. We should consider early region overflow thresholds and a pre-warm policy for adjacent regions.
ryan.oncall: Incident will remain open until quota resolution and autoscaler errors resolved. For now, mitigation stable. I'll hand this to infra for follow-up. @jonah.ops you own quota ticket; @lena.runtime you own runtime follow-ups; @maya.sre keep monitoring for 2 hours.
jonah.ops: Acknowledged. I'll update ticket with routing telemetry and customer impact notes.
oliver.cs: Sharing final update to customers: temporary cross-region routing enabled; their traffic may have small perf variance. Will escalate if anything else.
incident-bot: Incident state changed: MONITORING -> MITIGATED at 2032023490. Pager cleared.
ryan.oncall: Thanks team. Postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow, include: autoscaler quota handling, routing playbook clarity, per-tenant tokens for critical paths. :thumbsup:
